title: Clients authenticate with OAuth 2.0 client credentials; tokens expire after 15 minutes
Every endpoint except /health requires a valid, signed bearer token
Scopes restrict each client to the operations its role needs
A client can only see and use keys it owns
Clear key material is never returned by any endpoint
Keys are bound to one usage (PIN, MAC, key encryption) and refused for any other
PIN translation supports ISO-0 and ISO-4 and validates PIN blocks
MAC generation and verification detect any change to the message
Malformed or hostile input returns a 4xx without internal detail or reflected input
Sensitive operations are audited without logging PINs, data or keys
Cryptographic endpoints are rate limited per client
Ten failed authentications lock the client for 15 minutes
Responses carry security headers (HSTS, nosniff, no-store, CSP) and no server banner
Request bodies larger than 16 KB are rejected
